program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source = '''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    squares = []
    for r in range(h - 1):
        for c in range(w - 1):
            if all(grid[rr][cc] == 2 for rr in (r, r + 1) for cc in (c, c + 1)):
                corners = [(r - 1, c - 1), (r - 1, c + 2), (r + 2, c - 1), (r + 2, c + 2)]
                if all(0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w and grid[rr][cc] != 0 for rr, cc in corners):
                    squares.append((r, c, corners))
    for r, c, corners in squares:
        tl, tr, bl, br = corners
        values = [grid[rr][cc] for rr, cc in corners]
        # Rotate the four corner colors clockwise, then extend each outward diagonal.
        colors = [values[3], values[0], values[1], values[2]]
        dirs = [(-1, -1), (-1, 1), (1, -1), (1, 1)]
        for (rr, cc), color, (dr, dc) in zip(corners, colors, dirs):
            out[rr][cc] = color
            rr += dr
            cc += dc
            while 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w:
                out[rr][cc] = color
                rr += dr
                cc += dc
    return out
'''
program_path.write_text(source)
ns={}
exec(compile(source, str(program_path), 'exec'),ns)
